exercise.title: First late train
exercise.prompt:
A station board lists how many minutes late each train arrived, in order.

Write `first_late(times, limit)` that returns the first delay strictly greater than `limit`, or `-1` when every train was on time enough.

Constraints: `times` holds 0 to 1000 whole numbers and `limit` is a whole number.

Example: `first_late([3, 5, 9], 6)` returns `9`. `first_late([1, 2], 6)` returns `-1`.
